0x001464.en: 「I am Umbra... the dark shade that brings death.」

0x00149E.en: 「You of blood and flesh... scatter in terror.」

0x00153D.en: 「Fed by the negative waves of this world,/　the "Lord of Ruin" shall come.」

0x001593.en: 「All things fall into beautiful ruin.../　together with us, the Ruina.」

0x0015E0.en: 「Die amid unbearable despair and terror,/　human.」

0x00162A.en: 「You who are fated for ruin.../　wrapped in hatred and suffering, meet your end.」

0x001698.en: 「You and that machine/　could become quite dangerous...」

0x0016E8.en: 「Its mechanism is incomplete,/　it may bring an unwanted result...」

0x001735.en: 「Offer your blood and flesh to the "Lord of Ruin" too.」

0x001775.en: 「A little more... a little more and you...」

0x0017AC.en: 「So that's how you stopped the change...」

0x0017E3.en: 「Offering, blood and flesh to the "Lord of Ruin"...」

0x001820.en: 「Incomplete as it is, that human swayed it...」

0x001860.en: 「Defy fate as you will, the end is the same...」

0x00198A.en: 「So a human turns aside my power...」

0x0019E3.en: 「I see... so you can break even me...」

0x001A48.en: 「Ahh.../　that dark power welcomes the "Lord of Ruin".」

0x001AD5.en: 「That will, that power,/　becomes the "Lord of Ruin's" sustenance...」

0x001B22.en: 「Resist how you may, fate is decided...」

0x001B62.en: 「Strong human.../　every living thing/　walks the road to ruin.」

0x001BC5.en: 「Human... so you use that mechanism that way...」

0x001C05.en: 「That machine... will it be an obstacle?」

0x001C67.en: 「You must understand.../　that ruin cannot be escaped.」

0x001CEB.en: 「Tears of grief and red blood/　make a wondrous wine...」

0x001D3B.en: 「I see./　So this is the power that repelled Aquila and Ignis.」

0x001D8B.en: 「How delightful.../　such fierce resistance.../　what death-cries will you raise?」

0x001DFD.en: 「That will of yours,/ I'll drown it in cries of pain and grief.」

0x001E59.en: 「Human, when you see the "Lord of Ruin," you will...」

0x001E9F.en: 「Human, keep using that mechanism and you will...」

0x001EE2.en: 「So you'll walk with humans, to the end?」

0x001F10.en: 「It's futile, human. You cannot stop it.」

0x001F50.en: 「You who bear the fate of ruin./　That time draws near.」

0x001FCE.en: 「A heart crushed by despair is great sustenance...」

0x002011.en: 「Human, perish never knowing that mechanism's true worth.」

0x002054.en: 「Human, you are using that mechanism wrongly.」

0x0020C8.en: 「To think a Melior Esse/ would bond with a human...」

0x002112.en: 「How long do you mean to struggle?」

0x002174.en: 「If you mean to defeat me, you'll need another way.」

0x0021B7.en: 「Even if you cling to life in vain...」

0x0022A7.en: 「Let me hear it... your sweet cry of despair.」

0x0022DE.en: 「Accept it... your fate of death and ruin.」

0x00234C.en: 「Now, a beautiful ruin for you all!」

0x00237D.en: 「Flesh and soul, I'll carve it all.」
